ruling.explanation:
To both parties. Trip TRP-02814 was booked on an upfront quote, so the distance and time charges were fixed at booking. Rider: you were quoted SGD 21.50 and charged SGD 31.80. Under POL-RD-11, on an upfront-quoted trip POL-RD-02 does not run and no distance-or-time refund is available however long the route was; your remedy is the amount by which the charged total exceeds the quote plus only the pass-through and statutory lines properly chargeable under POL-RD-09. Those lines are all zero here — no ERP gantries crossed, no airport surcharge (the trip neither originates nor ends at an airport), no waiting-time fee — so the refund is charged_total SGD 31.80 − quoted fare SGD 21.50 − properly chargeable SGD 0.00 = SGD 10.30, rounded up to the nearest 5 cents = SGD 10.30. That figure is the fare breakdown's own pol_rd_11_remedy and it is the whole of your recovery. Driver: the GPS trace (EV-GPS-02814) measures 19.71 km against the booked optimal of 14.6 km, an excess of 5.11 km and 35.00%, which establishes a route deviation under POL-RD-01 — both the 20% and the 0.8 km tests pass, and the trace figure governs over the trip record's rounded 19.7 km copy. It is not a material deviation (5.11 km is below the 8.0 km and 35.00% below the 50% materiality tests), so no POL-RD-06 driver-profile check, no FULL_REFUND uplift and no conduct referral arise; the driver profile (deviation_flags_90d 0 over 396 completed 90-day trips) shows no repeat pattern in any event. The trace is clean for policy purposes under POL-RD-07 — 155 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100% coverage, no gaps — so the deviation stands on the trace alone and no independent corroboration was needed. Your statement that 'the meter adds the extra distance' cites no evidence ID and invokes no clause, so under POL-RD-08 it carries no weight as an exculpation, and there is no traffic advisory on file for this trip (the bundle's only advisory, EV-ADVIS-02814-01, is MISSING at weight 0.0), so no external-cause excuse under POL-RD-03/POL-RD-13 is available. No rider-requested detour or relocation applies: the chat log carries zero messages, so POL-RD-04 is unavailable, and no pickup or dropoff amendment was recorded, so POL-RD-05 cannot be run. The pass-through lines are clean, so POL-RD-09 yields no separate correction and no billing-integrity referral; no clause produces any referral in this case. Confidence is 0.95, below the cap of 1.0 set by the deciding artifacts (the fare breakdown and the GPS trace, each at weight 1.0). Because the monetary effect (SGD 10.30) exceeds the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, this provisional ruling is issued but held for release by a human reviewer under POL-GEN-05; either party may appeal once under POL-GEN-04.
